name: Blood-Spiller (Bloodrager Archetype)
body:
Blood-Spillers remember every insult and injury, repaying each and every one twofold.

A blood-spiller has the following class features.

Blood Enemy (Ex)

A blood-spiller will track his foe to the ends of the planet.

At 3rd level, he adds 1/2 his blood-spiller level to Survival skill checks made to follow tracks.

This replaces blood sanctuary.

Vendetta (Ex)

At 6th level, as a swift action, a blood-spiller can denote a creature to be the subject of his vendetta. A blood-spiller must be able to see the creature, and it must have caused damage to him or one of his allies. The blood-spiller gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls against the subject of his vendetta until it dies or the blood-spiller selects another creature to be the subject of his vendetta. At 12th level, these bonuses increase to +2. A blood-spiller can have only one vendetta active at a time, and he must wait at least 1 minute after issuing a vendetta before issuing another.

This replaces the bonus bloodline feat at 6th and 12th level.

Spiteful Spell Slinger

At 7th level, and every level a blood-spiller gains a bloodline spell, he can choose to select one of the following spells at the prescribed levels instead: stunning barrier (7th), castigate (10th), greater stunning barrier (13th), shared wrath (16th).

At 14th level, once per day, after suffering hit point damage from a spell targeting only the blood-spiller, he can, as an immediate action, cause the spell’s caster to suffer the same type and amount of hit point damage. This is a supernatural ability with no save.

This alters bloodline spell and replaces indomitable will.

Spiteful Strike (Sp)

At 9th level, upon making a successful melee or ranged weapon attack against the target of his vendetta, a blood-spiller can use a swift action to curse the target in addition to inflicting weapon damage. This curse lasts for 1 minute and counts as bestow curse. A successful Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the bloodspiller’s level + his Charisma modifier) reduces the duration of the curse to 1 round. A blood-spiller can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Charisma modifier. A creature cannot suffer from the same curse more than once in a 24 hour period.

A blood-spiller can select one of the following curses at 9th level, and one additional curse at 15th and 18th level.

Bloody Wounds: Whenever the target takes piercing or slashing damage, it also takes 1 point of bleed damage.

Concussed: Whenever the target attempts an attack, it suffers a 10% miss chance.

Unbalanced: The target suffers a -4 circumstance penalty to its Dexterity.

Weakened Limbs: The target suffers a -2 circumstance penalty on damage rolls and its speed is decreased by 10 feet.

This replaces the bonus feats gained at 9th, 15th, and 18th level.
